_comment: English locale for Word Ladder. Keys (left) are fixed; translate only the values (right). Keep every {placeholder} verbatim. Word tokens ({start_word}, {target_word}, {word}, {current}, {ladder}) are neutral game words and must not be translated. Keep the bracket example `[word]` as-is.

_slots.{start_word}: The starting word of the ladder (neutral token)
_slots.{target_word}: The target word to reach (neutral token)
_slots.{word}: The word the player just submitted (neutral token)
_slots.{ladder}: The move history joined by ' -> ' (neutral tokens)
_slots.{history}: The rendered history line (already localized; do not translate)
_slots.{pct}: Percentage of letters shared with the target (integer)

prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id}.  Your goal is to reach the target word by changing **one letter at a time**.
- Start word:  **{start_word}**
- Target word: **{target_word}**
Submit each move in square brackets, e.g.  `[word]`.
History appears below as you play.  Good luck!

invalid.wrong_format: Invalid format. Wrap your word in square brackets, e.g. `[word]`.
invalid.wrong_length: `{word}` has wrong length; target is {target_len} letters.
invalid.not_a_word: `{word}` is not a recognised English word.
invalid.not_one_different: `{word}` is not exactly one letter different from `{current}`.

outcome.win: Congratulations! You reached the target word.
outcome.turn_limit: The turn limit has been reached. You reached `{current}` which shares {pct}% of its letters with the target `{target}`.
